marketRadar.title: Market Opportunity Radar
marketRadar.subtitle: Market signals ranked against your shop goals and price range.
marketRadar.heroStrongFitHint: Opportunities scoring 75+ for market potential and fit with your profile.
marketRadar.heroRisingHint: Niches whose buyer engagement is trending up across recent observations.
marketRadar.heroToReviewHint: New opportunities you have not saved, ignored or acted on yet.
marketRadar.miniRisingNewHint: under 90 days old, 3+ favorites a month
marketRadar.miniMedianFavoritesHint: a month, median of the top
marketRadar.tileRising: New listings already in the top
marketRadar.tileRisingCaption: Listings under 90 days old that already gain 3+ favorites a month
marketRadar.competitorMomentumCaption: Strong shops / all shops in the top sample. A strong shop has a top listing gaining 3+ favorites a month.
marketRadar.miniRisingNew: New listings already in the top
marketRadar.leaderboardTitle: Shops holding the most top listings
marketRadar.leaderboardShare: Together these {{total}} shops hold {{held}} of the {{sample}} top listings sampled ({{share}}%). Open their best listing to see what wins.
marketRadar.leaderboardNoShare: Open their best listing to see what wins.
marketRadar.leaderboardNote: Shops are numbered by how many top listings they hold; the link opens their best listing. Share is of the top listings sampled.
marketRadar.priceStripTitle: Where top shops set their price
marketRadar.priceStripProfile: {{inside}} of {{total}} top shops price inside your target range; {{below}} sit below the typical band and {{above}} above it.
marketRadar.priceStripNoProfile: {{below}} of {{total}} top shops sit below the typical band and {{above}} above it. Add a target price range to your profile to place yourself.
marketRadar.nicheMapLabel: Tracked niches by competition and buyer interest
marketRadar.nicheMapSubtitle: {{count}} niches matched to your profile. Higher means buyers engage more; further left means fewer strong shops. Split at the median niche: {{fav}} favorites / month, {{share}}% strong shops.
marketRadar.nicheMapNoOpening: No niche beats the median on both interest and competition yet.
marketRadar.sweetSpotLine: Listings priced {{range}} draw interest most often: {{share}}% gain 1+ favorite a month, against {{overall}}% across the niche.
marketRadar.sweetSpotMoreListings: +{{count}} more in this band — all listings are in the table below.
marketRadar.sweetSpotInside: Inside your target price range — price your listing here.
marketRadar.sweetSpotPartial: Overlaps your target price range — aim for the overlapping part.
marketRadar.sweetSpotBelow: Below your target price range — you would compete on price, or need a premium angle to sell higher.
marketRadar.sweetSpotAbove: Above your target price range — buyers here pay more than you planned to charge.
marketRadar.sweetSpotNoProfile: Add a target price range to your seller profile to compare it with this band.
marketRadar.sweetSpotNone: No clear sweet spot: {{overall}}% of listings gain 1+ favorite a month and no price band beats that by {{lead}} points. Price is not what sets listings apart here — design and keywords are.
marketRadar.sweetSpotNote: Each band holds a quarter of the top listings. "Active" means 1+ favorite a month. Click a band to see its listings.
marketRadar.seasonSubtitle: Upcoming US gifting occasions and the opportunities in your radar that sell for them.
marketRadar.seasonListNowHint: Best time to publish: new listings need weeks to rank before buyers shop.
marketRadar.seasonLastCallHint: Too late for new listings to rank; promote what is already live.
marketRadar.seasonPlanHint: Prepare designs and mockups so they are ready to list.
marketRadar.seasonNoMatch: No matching opportunity in your radar yet.
marketRadar.sellerProfileDescription: This context changes the ranking you receive. It is never shared with other sellers.
marketRadar.shopGoalPlaceholder: e.g. Find profitable personalized home decor niches for Q4
marketRadar.recommendedDescription: Sorted by market potential and fit with your seller profile.
marketRadar.nextActionActed: Review the result and measure the listing when data is available.
marketRadar.nextActionSaved: Use the evidence to shape a differentiated listing concept.
marketRadar.nextActionReview: Review the evidence and run the AI analyst before committing time.
marketRadar.strongestMatch: Strongest current match for your seller profile.
marketRadar.radarReadyDescription: Your profile is saved. Build the radar after market data has been collected by the research sync.
marketRadar.setupProfileDescription: Tell the radar about your shop goal, audiences and price range so opportunities can be ranked for you.
marketRadar.earlySignal: Early signal only — collect more listings and observation periods before making a large investment.
marketRadar.confidenceExplanation: Confidence shows how much evidence backs the market score. It does not change the fit score.
marketRadar.compareDescription: Select up to three opportunities to make the trade-off visible.
marketRadar.priceSaleWarning: Many shops run sales all the time; buyers may pay much less than the list price.
marketRadar.tileListPricePositionCaptionCurrency: Where top listings set their list price ({{currency}}, middle half). Compare your own list price with it.
marketRadar.tileListPricePositionCaption: Where top listings set their list price (middle half). Compare your own list price with it.
marketRadar.demandPace: These listings gain {{count}} favorites a day
marketRadar.marketSignalsSetupAlt: Save your seller profile to match public Etsy market signals to your niche.
marketRadar.marketSignalsLoadingNiche: Calculating your niche conclusion from public Etsy data...
marketRadar.marketSignalsLoadingShort: Calculating your niche from public Etsy data...
marketRadar.marketSignalsErrorNiche: The niche conclusion could not be loaded. Try refreshing the radar.
marketRadar.noMatchingSignalsAlt: No collected market signals match this seller profile yet.
marketRadar.noMatchingSignalsHintNote: These signals come from public Etsy snapshots collected by the admin Market Insights job.
marketRadar.nicheMapSubtitleShort: {{count}} niches. Click one to open it below.
marketRadar.profilePresetHint: Match the profile to the apparel dataset to improve relevance and seller fit.
marketRadar.marketSignalsDescription: Keyword-level insights from the shared public Etsy dataset, matched to your seller profile.
marketRadar.marketSignalsSetup: Save your seller profile above to match public Etsy market signals to your niche.
marketRadar.marketSignalsError: Market signals could not be loaded. Try refreshing the radar.
marketRadar.noMatchingSignals: No market group matches this seller profile yet.
marketRadar.noMatchingSignalsHint: Run the admin Market Insights collection with keywords close to this niche.
marketRadar.confidenceLine: Confidence {{quality}} · {{listings}} top listings · {{days}} day(s) of data
marketRadar.tileMarketInfo: Etsy's own count of active listings for this niche's keywords. The badge is how that count moved across the collected days; more listings means more supply to compete with. The rank compares it with the other tracked niches.
marketRadar.tileStrongSellersShort: strong shops / shops at the top
marketRadar.tileStrongSellersInfo: A strong shop has a top listing gaining 3+ favorites a month. Top 5 is the share of the top listings held by the five largest shops: the lower it is, the less any shop owns the niche.
marketRadar.tileRisingInfo: Top listings under 90 days old that already gain 3+ favorites a month. Above zero means a newcomer can still reach the top here.
marketRadar.tileDemandShort: favorites per top listing a month (median)
marketRadar.tileDemandInfo: Favorites are the public interest signal Etsy shares; sales are not public. The bar is the share of top listings that get at least one favorite a month.
marketRadar.scatterSubtitleShort: Each dot is a top listing: right is pricier, up gets more favorites. Orange dots are under 90 days old.
marketRadar.listingAgeCaption: Median age of the top listings
marketRadar.listingsToLearnFromDescription: Under 90 days old and already gaining favorites. Study them; do not copy them.
marketRadar.publicSignalsNote: Favorites are public interest signals from Etsy, not sales or revenue.
marketRadar.compareOverallHint: 60% listing heat, 40% fit with your shop
marketRadar.compareHeatHint: How fast this listing gains favorites and views
marketRadar.compareFitHint: Category, keywords and price against your profile
marketRadar.compareCompetitionHint: Size of the niche on Etsy against the other tracked niches
marketRadar.compareStrongShopsHint: Shops at the top already gaining 3+ favorites a month; fewer is easier to enter
marketRadar.compareDemandHint: Median favorites per 30 days of the niche's top listings
marketRadar.compareRisingHint: Listings under 90 days old already gaining favorites: proof newcomers can sell
marketRadar.compareMixedCurrency: List prices in different currencies are not compared
marketRadar.compareEvidenceHint: Listings and days of data behind the niche figures
marketRadar.compareSweepDetail: Leads on overall score, room for new shops and buyer demand. Test it first.
marketRadar.compareNoVerdict: These opportunities are too close to call on score, competition and demand.
marketRadar.compareTieDetail: Tied, or not enough niche data
marketRadar.nicheOpenForNewSellers: {{count}} listing(s) under 90 days old in this niche already gain favorites quickly.
marketRadar.scatterLabel: Price against favorites per month for the top listings
marketRadar.listPriceNote: Prices are the list prices Etsy reports, before sales and coupons. Shops running a sale charge less at checkout, and buyers abroad may see a converted price with VAT added.
marketRadar.scatterHidden: {{count}} listing(s) priced above {{price}} are not shown; they are in the table.
marketRadar.nicheMapMethod: Each dot is a niche matched to your profile. Up: buyers favorite its top listings more. Left: fewer of its top shops are strong. The green corner beats the median niche on both ({{fav}} favorites / month, {{share}}% strong shops).
marketRadar.keywordCoverageEmpty: Add preferred keywords so the radar knows which products you make.
marketRadar.keywordCoverageGaps: Opportunities in your radar ({{total}}) that mention each keyword. {{count}} keyword(s) match nothing: no market data is collected for them yet, so they do not help the ranking.
marketRadar.keywordCoverageAll: Opportunities in your radar ({{total}}) that mention each keyword. Every keyword matches at least one.
marketRadar.priceFitTitle: Your price range against the radar
marketRadar.priceFitLine: {{inside}} of {{total}} opportunities have a typical price inside {{range}}; {{below}} are cheaper and {{above}} dearer.
marketRadar.priceFitNone: Set a target price range to see how many opportunities it covers.
marketRadar.suggestLine: Opportunities scoring {{score}}+ that none of your keywords mention. Adding one saves your profile and re-ranks the radar.
marketRadar.suggestNone: Your keywords already cover every opportunity scoring {{score}} or more.
marketRadar.sweetSpotMethod: Prices are Etsy list prices before sales and coupons; many shops discount all the time, so buyers often pay less. Each band holds a quarter of the top listings; "active" means 1+ favorite a month. Click a band to see its listings.
marketRadar.sweetSpotTooFew: Too few priced listings to compare price bands yet.
marketRadar.showListings: Show every listing on a chart
marketRadar.seasonMethod: US gifting occasions in the next {{days}} days. Products are matched by the words in their niche and title (for example christmas, xmas, ugly sweater). The lead times are common Etsy practice: a new listing needs weeks to rank before buyers shop.
marketRadar.seasonNoMatchLate: No product in your radar, and too late to start one.
marketRadar.seasonNoMatchGap: No product in your radar yet: a gap worth filling.

connectEtsy.title: Connect an Etsy shop
connectEtsy.description: Connect your Etsy shop so Podivo can prepare and publish listings from your workspace.
connectEtsy.step1: Open API keys from the Workspace menu and select Add API key.
connectEtsy.step2: Choose Etsy and start the connection flow.
connectEtsy.step3: Sign in to the correct Etsy account and approve the requested permissions.
connectEtsy.step4: Return to Podivo and confirm that the connection status is Connected.
connectEtsy.note: Use the Etsy account that owns the shop you want Podivo to publish to.

fixApiKey.title: Fix an API key
fixApiKey.description: A key usually needs attention when it expired, was revoked, or no longer has the permissions Podivo requires.
fixApiKey.step1: Open API keys and find the provider that needs attention.
fixApiKey.step2: Confirm the key is still active in the provider account and has the required permissions.
fixApiKey.step3: Select Edit, paste the replacement key, and save your changes.
fixApiKey.step4: Run the connection check again and confirm the status is Connected.
fixApiKey.note: For security, Podivo only displays the masked credential. Never include a full API key in a support ticket.

credits.title: Understand credits
credits.description: Your plan includes an allowance used by generation and publishing activity in the workspace.
credits.step1: Open Usage to review images, videos, listings, and estimated provider costs.
credits.step2: Use the date-range selector to compare activity across different periods.
credits.step3: Check Credit allowance to see the amount used, the plan limit, and the reset date.
credits.step4: Open Billing if you need to review or change the subscription attached to the workspace.
credits.note: Usage data can take a short time to appear after a workflow finishes.

modelPhotosPanel.adminIntro: Photos of people every seller can put their mock-ups on. Use a person facing the camera in a plain white or light garment.
modelPhotosPanel.sellerIntro: Photos of people your mock-ups are put on, without AI: the garment takes the mock-up’s color and design. The shared photos are listed too.
modelPhotosPanel.unavailableDescription: We could not load the model photos. Check your connection and try again.
modelPhotosPanel.deleteDescription: It is no longer offered for new images. Images already made on it stay as they are.
modelPhotosPanel.noFilteredTitle: No model photos of these people

modelPhotosPanel.noPhotosDescription: Add a photo of a person in a plain white tee to put your mock-ups on it, or make one with AI.

generateModelPhoto.title: Make a model photo with AI
generateModelPhoto.description: AI makes a photo of the people you choose in a plain white t-shirt. It is kept with your model photos, and mock-ups are put on it without AI, so the print stays exactly as designed.
generateModelPhoto.costNote: One Ideogram image (about $0.03), made on your own key, or on the platform's keys when your plan includes them. Making it takes up to a minute. Check the photo before you use it: if the shirt is not found, make another.
generateModelPhoto.pendingNote: Making the photo and finding the shirt on it… this takes up to a minute.

modelPhotoForm.description: A person wearing a plain white or light garment, facing the camera. Mock-ups are put on it without AI: the garment takes the mock-up’s color and design.
modelPhotoForm.garmentDescription: Only the garment (blue) takes the mock-up’s color and print; skin and the background keep theirs.
modelPhotoForm.garmentPendingNote: Finding the garment on the photo… this takes a few seconds.
modelPhotoForm.garmentFoundNote: It was found automatically, and is found again at the photo’s full size when you save.
modelPhotoForm.garmentSavedNote: This is the garment saved with the photo.
modelPhotoForm.garmentManualNote: It could not be found automatically: click it on the photo to select it.
modelPhotoForm.garmentOtherNote: The person could not be found either, so take care not to select the background.
modelPhotoForm.placementAutoDescription: The shirt is measured on both photos: the design keeps its size relative to the chest and its distance below the collar, as on the mock-up. Nothing to mark.
modelPhotoForm.placementManualLabel: In a print area I mark
modelPhotoForm.placementManualDescription: Drag its four corners onto the chest: for a pose the automatic placement gets wrong, such as a person turned a little to the side.
modelPhotoForm.coverChestNote: Cover the same part of the garment as your mock-up templates’ print area (for a tee, the chest). A design is placed in it as it is on the mock-up.
modelPhotoForm.selectGarmentFirstNote: Select the garment first: the print area then sits on its chest, ready to adjust.
modelPhotoForm.drawAreaError: Draw a print area on the photo.
modelPhotoForm.garmentFoundShirts: Found {{count}} shirts: each one gets the design.
modelPhotoForm.garmentFoundOneShirt: Found 1 shirt. People standing close together count as one: leave a gap between them so each one gets the design.
modelPhotoForm.photoTooSmall: This photo is small ({{width}} × {{height}} px): the garment’s edge and the print will look rough. Use a photo at least {{minSide}} px on its longer side.
modelPhotoForm.incompleteGroup: Choose who the group is: a family, friends or a couple.
modelPhotoForm.incompleteSingle: Choose the person's age group and gender.
modelPhotoForm.garmentRequired: Click the garment on the photo to select it: it is what takes the mock-up’s color.
modelPhotoForm.encodingError: The selection could not be prepared. Try again.
modelPhotoForm.placementError: Put the print area's corners back in order before saving.
modelPhotoForm.photoTooSmallForCreate: Add a photo of a person wearing a plain, light garment.

printQuad.instructionsValid: Drag a corner to follow the chest, or drag inside to move the area. The design is warped onto it.
printQuad.instructionsInvalid: The corners cross or go round the wrong way. Keep them in order: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.

printAreaList.heading: Print area
printAreaList.description: Drag the box on the photo to place the design. The round handle above it turns it.

printAreaEditor.turnTitle: Drag to turn. Hold Shift for steps of 15°.
printAreaEditor.offPhotoNote: The turned print area reaches off the photo. Make it smaller or move it further in.
printAreaEditor.offGarmentExclusive: The print area is entirely off the garment, so nothing of it would be printed. Move it onto the garment.
printAreaEditor.offGarmentPartial: Part of the print area is off the garment. Mock-ups cut it off at the garment’s edge.
printAreaEditor.frameNote: The green dashed box is Printify’s print area. Move, resize or turn the design inside it: it prints where it shows.
printAreaEditor.adjustGarmentNote: Drag the amber box to fit the garment exactly, then click Done.
printAreaEditor.snapCenterNote: Snaps to the center of the amber garment box. Wrong? Adjust it.
printAreaEditor.snapNoGarmentNote: Snaps to the photo's center — mark the garment area for better centering.
printAreaEditor.selectedAllOffNote: The design is entirely off the garment, so nothing of it would be printed. Move it onto the garment.
printAreaEditor.selectedPartOffNote: Part of the design is off the garment. Mock-ups cut it off at the garment’s edge.

garmentSelection.loadError: The photo could not be read for selecting the garment. Choose the photo again.
garmentSelection.autoNote: The garment was found automatically. Check that only it is blue (no skin, hair, or other clothes); fix it with the brush if needed.
garmentSelection.selectionNote: Selected: {{percent}}% of the photo. Only the garment should be blue: no skin, hair, or other clothes.
garmentSelection.clickNote: Click the garment to select it. Add what the click missed with the brush; erase anything that is not the garment.

templateForm.description: Mark where designs go on each photo. Add the back or a sleeve to print there too: each side makes its own mock-up.
templateForm.descriptionPrintifyLocked: The photos and Printify's print area stay as they are while the template is linked to Printify: place the design inside it. Measure a side again, or unlink it, in Printify settings.
templateForm.allowRecolorDescription: Any garment color, on every side. Needs a white or light-gray garment on a plain background.
templateForm.garmentColorUsedNote: Used unless a batch picks its own colors. None keeps the photo’s color.
templateForm.realisticPrintNote: Saving also prepares realistic printing (fabric folds and shadows) for this photo.
templateForm.frontRequiredError: Add a photo of the front for the new template.
templateForm.areaOffPhotoError: {{view}}: {{label}} reaches off the photo. Move it onto the photo or make it smaller.
templateForm.areasPrintNothingError: {{view}}: every print area prints nothing. Let at least one print the mock-up's design.
templateForm.drawAreaError: Draw a print area on the front photo.
templateForm.lockedNote: Custom mock-up templates are part of Pro.
templateForm.garmentColorPrintifyNote: One of the colors measured on Printify. Used unless a batch picks its own colors. None keeps the photo’s color.
templateForm.garmentColorNoPrintifyColors: No Printify colors measured for this blueprint yet. Measure them in Printify settings.

sidesEditor.findingGarment: Finding the garment in the photo… this takes a few seconds.
sidesEditor.printifyLockedDropDescription: The sides of a Printify template are Printify's own photos. Add this one from the template's Printify settings.
sidesEditor.frontDropDescription: A real product photo, garment on a plain background. Images up to 10 MB.
sidesEditor.sideDropDescription: Add a photo of the {{label}} to print on it too: every design gets a mock-up of this side.
sidesEditor.sideAreasNote: Print areas for the {{label}} appear once it has a photo.
sidesEditor.sideOffPhotoWarning: The {{label}} photo can’t be recolored: {{reason}} Use a white or light-gray garment on a plain background.

Review AI clips and every generated keyframe for product fidelity.
